subject: XFN weekly: triage followbacks and exec ask queue
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: XFN weekly: triage followbacks and exec ask queue

Team —

Quick kickoff for this week's cross-functional followbacks. After the sync we captured a handful of exec asks + roadmap exceptions that need owners and ETA so the QBR packet is accurate. I attached the working triage matrix and a short PDF with the current exec ask wording. Please do three things by EOD Monday: 

- Owners: confirm owner(s) and add a 1-line ETA in the triage spreadsheet (column: "Owner / ETA").
- Ask clarity: if the ask requires a product decision, add "product-decision" to the tags column and include a short rationale.
- Customer impact: flag anything with > 1 customer impacted as high priority.

Summary of the top items from the sync: 
1) Canary fallback policy: request from Acme Cloud—need timeline and rollback plan for Dedicated fallback.
2) Latency SLO exception for the streaming endpoint (BeamTech pilot).
3) Billing model question: marketplace listing price vs. committed capacity.

I've pre-assigned items in the triage sheet where possible, but some need clearer owners. I'm proposing we slot the high-impact items for a 30-min deep-dive on Thursday 4/08 with engineering and sales. Please reply with owner/ETA or mark as "needs discussion."

Attachments: QBR_exec_asks_20270404.pdf, triage-matrix-20270404.xlsx

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-04T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: XFN weekly: triage followbacks and exec ask queue

Diego —

Thanks for the clear ask. I'm taking owner for the Acme Cloud fallback policy item and will coordinate with our SRE lead to get an ETA. Preliminary plan:
- Week of 4/11: design and validation plan
- Week of 4/18: limited canary rollout on Dedicated (non-production)
- Rollback plan documented by 4/15

I'll update the triage sheet now. Marissa will also attach a short note on potential revenue impact if we have to provide extended fallbacks for Dedicated customers.

One question for product: BeamTech's latency SLO exception — is the ask to increase SLO for their pilot, or to run a dedicated inference queue? That changes effort estimates.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-04T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: XFN weekly: triage followbacks and exec ask queue

Acked — I'm slotting the 4/08 deep-dive on the calendar for 30 minutes and inviting the SRE and CS leads. Diego, please confirm which items must be in the QBR packet vs. follow-up after QBR; we'll prioritize packet items first.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Strategy Operations
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-04T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: XFN weekly: triage followbacks and exec ask queue

Diego / Marissa —

Quick clarifications on scope: 
- BeamTech latency: product preference is to avoid per-customer SLOs when possible. Can we vet whether the issue is due to model selection or infra config (quantization/packing)? If it's infra, ops can short-circuit with config changes. If model, this becomes a roadmap ask.
- Marketplace pricing vs committed capacity: this is a Sales + Finance discussion. Priyom, can you surface the current marketplace anchor price and any pending offers?

For the Thursday deep-dive, I'll bring a 2-slide proposal: (1) short-term ops mitigations, (2) product-level options (variance in model variants / small-quant Qs).

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product
From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@beamtech.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-ops@acme-cloud.com, partners@greenstack.io
Date: 2027-04-05T11:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: XFN weekly: triage followbacks and exec ask queue

Diego / Marissa —

Appreciate the quick attention. For BeamTech: the pilot is sensitive to tail latency for short chattier sessions. We tried the packing tweaks you recommended last sprint; saw some improvement but still hit 95th-percentile spikes. Our ask is twofold: one temporary SLA adjustment for the pilot window (4/10–5/10) and a proposal for a dedicated inference queue if the pilot scales.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can commit a temporary SLO window and what the expected delta in cost/throughput would be? Also happy to join the deep-dive on 4/08 if helpful.

Best,
Sarah Connors
Head of Infrastructure, BeamTech
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, sarah.connors@beamtech.com
Date: 2027-04-06T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: XFN weekly: triage followbacks and exec ask queue — consolidated owners and next steps

Thanks everyone — consolidating outcomes and next steps so the QBR packet has clean language.

Decisions / owners: 
- Acme fallback policy: Owner = marissa_cole; ETA for rollback plan doc: 2027-04-15. (Marissa to provide revenue-impact note.)
- BeamTech latency: Owner = vivek_kulkarni + SRE; pre-deep-dive ops mitigation plan by 2027-04-07 EOD. Short-term SLO window (4/10–5/10) — Diego to coordinate legal/CS for customer agreement; Marissa will confirm cost delta.
- Marketplace pricing question: Owner = priyom_das; Priyom to share anchor pricing and proposed delta by 2027-04-08.

Action items I will do now: update the QBR_exec_asks_20270404.pdf with the finalized owner lines, push the triage spreadsheet to "Owner / ETA confirmed" status for items above, and put the 4/08 invite on calendars.

If anyone needs to escalate an ask into an exec decision, mark it in the triage sheet with "EXEC-ESCALATE" and I'll route it to the appropriate exec briefly.

Diego
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
